notes: The presentative frame *There is* was placed on the prepositional predicate under rules 49 and 20, the dummy joining the unit that bears the copula; heading it on the subject noun אוֹצָר is the materially different alternative and is named here under rule 8.
*swalloweth ... up* is one verb with its phrasal particle, discontinuous around the object suffix (rules 44 and 25).
